answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 82 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. The copper register is checked at draw time, grove lists the eligible set, and nebula seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 82 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary burns for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 16 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
